methodologyNotes: This dataset covers 13 current-generation FDM and MSLA resin 3D printers spanning entry-level to prosumer segments, including models from Bambu Lab, Prusa, Creality, Anycubic, Elegoo, and Sovol. Specifications were re-verified against manufacturer product pages (bambulab.com, prusa3d.com, store.creality.com, store.anycubic.com, us.elegoo.com, sovol3d.com), official spec sheets, and corroborated by reputable review/retail sources (Tom's Hardware, 3D Printing Industry, MatterHackers, West3D, 3DPros database). priceUsd reflects published US MSRP from the manufacturer's US storefront or an official US reseller; where a product is frequently discounted, the regular published price is used and the priceNote records typical street/sale pricing. Boolean specKeys (auto_leveling, multicolor, enclosed) are true only when the feature is present on the base unit without additional purchase (so single-color FDM bases whose multicolor requires a separately purchased AMS/ACE unit are multicolor=false; the H2D is multicolor=true because its dual hardened-steel nozzles do 2-material printing natively). Resin (MSLA) printers leave max_speed_mms and max_hotend_temp_c null as inapplicable. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Bambu Lab A1
products.priceNote: MSRP base unit $399; A1 Combo with AMS Lite $559 (current Bambu US store regular price)
products.provenance: Build volume 256x256x256 mm, max speed 500 mm/s, hotend 300C, and auto-leveling confirmed via Bambu Lab A1 tech-specs page and 3DPros. Base MSRP $399 confirmed. Multicolor requires the separately bought AMS Lite, so set false on the base unit per methodology. Combo price corrected to $559 (current Bambu US store; older trackers list $649).

products.name: Bambu Lab A1 mini
products.priceNote: MSRP base unit $299; A1 mini Combo with AMS Lite $449
products.provenance: Build volume 180x180x180 mm confirmed via Bambu Lab spec sheet and 3DPros. Max speed 500 mm/s and hotend 300C confirmed. Base MSRP $299 and Combo $449 confirmed via Bambu US store. Multicolor requires the separately bought AMS Lite, so false on the base unit.

products.name: Bambu Lab P1S
products.priceNote: MSRP base unit $699 (frequently discounted to ~$399-499); P1S Combo with AMS ~$899
products.provenance: All specs confirmed via 3DPros and Bambu US store listing. Fully enclosed with activated-carbon filter. Multicolor requires the separately bought AMS, so false on the base unit. Base MSRP $699 confirmed (regularly on sale near $399).

products.name: Bambu Lab X1-Carbon
products.priceNote: MSRP base unit ~$1,199; Combo with AMS ~$1,449
products.provenance: Specs confirmed via 3DPros and 3Dnatives. Dual auto bed leveling plus Micro Lidar; enclosed with tinted glass. Max speed 500 mm/s, hotend 300C, build volume 256x256x256 mm confirmed. MSRP ~$1,199 confirmed via Bambu US store and price trackers. Multicolor requires separately bought AMS, so false on base unit.

products.name: Bambu Lab H2D
products.priceNote: MSRP base unit (3D only) $1,899; H2D AMS Combo $2,199; Laser Full Combo (10W) $2,799; (40W) $3,499
products.provenance: Build volume 350x320x325 mm (dual-nozzle), max speed 1000 mm/s, hotend 350C, and 65C heated chamber confirmed via Bambu launch blog and 3D Printing Industry. Pricing confirmed: base $1,899, AMS Combo $2,199, Laser 10W $2,799, 40W $3,499. AMS Combo shipped late March 2025; base 3D-only H2D released June 2025. Dual hardened-steel nozzles do 2-material printing natively, so multicolor=true.

products.name: Prusa MK4S
products.provenance: Build volume 250x210x220 mm, hotend 290C, and Loadcell auto-leveling confirmed via Prusa product page (assembled $999, kit $729). Prusa publishes no rated max travel speed in mm/s, so null (a null beats a guess). MK4S announced August 2024 as the MK4 upgrade.

products.name: Prusa CORE One
products.priceNote: Original CORE One assembled launch MSRP $1,199 (Jan 2025); current CORE One+ assembled $1,599; kit ~$949-1,049
products.provenance: Build volume 250x220x270 mm, fully enclosed with active chamber to 55C, hotend 290C, 600 mm/s travel, and Load Cell auto-leveling confirmed via Prusa product page and 3D Printing Industry. priceUsd set to the verified original CORE One assembled launch MSRP $1,199 (Jan 2025); the later CORE One+ assembled is $1,599, noted in priceNote. MMU3 multicolor is an optional add-on, so false.

products.name: Creality K1
products.priceNote: Published US price $599 (MatterHackers / Creality); occasionally discounted lower
products.provenance: Build volume 220x220x250 mm, max speed 600 mm/s, hotend 300C, enclosed design, and strain-based auto-leveling confirmed via MatterHackers (the cited source) and 3DPros. priceUsd corrected from an unverifiable $519 'street' figure to the published $599 shown on the cited MatterHackers listing. No multicolor.

products.name: Creality Ender-3 V3
products.priceNote: Launch/published MSRP ~$389-425; current street price may vary
products.provenance: Full Ender-3 V3 (CoreXZ variant, distinct from SE/KE). Build volume 220x220x250 mm, max speed 600 mm/s, hotend 300C, load-cell auto-leveling confirmed via 3DPros and Tom's Hardware. Released January/February 2024 with CoreXZ motion, Klipper firmware, direct drive. priceUsd adjusted 420->399 toward the commonly published Creality store MSRP (cited 3DPros lists $400-425). Open frame, no enclosure.

products.name: Anycubic Kobra 3
products.priceNote: MSRP base single unit $349; multicolor requires separately sold ACE Pro (Combo pricing varies)
products.provenance: Build volume 250x250x260 mm, max speed 600 mm/s, hotend 300C, LeviQ auto-leveling, and open-frame design confirmed via official Anycubic store page ($349 base). Released May 2024. ACE Pro multicolor system is a separate accessory, so multicolor=false on base unit. Removed the misleading 'Combo $329' claim from the note (a Combo would not be cheaper than the base except on temporary sale).

products.name: Elegoo Neptune 4 Pro
products.priceNote: Typical current US store price ~$269-284; launch MSRP was ~$330-360
products.provenance: Build volume 225x225x265 mm, max speed 500 mm/s, hotend 300C, and 121-point auto-leveling confirmed via Elegoo US store and MatterHackers. Launched June 2023. priceUsd $279 retained: within the verified recent US store/Amazon band ($269-284 per Tom's Hardware); the launch MSRP (~$330-360) is noted. No multicolor.

products.name: Elegoo Saturn 4 Ultra
products.priceNote: Regular MSRP for 12K model ~$524 (West3D regular $523.99); frequently on sale ~$369-380
products.provenance: MSLA resin printer: max_speed_mms and max_hotend_temp_c are inapplicable (resin measures speed in mm/h, up to ~150 mm/h via tilt-release), both null. Build volume 218.88x122.88x220 mm and 12K resolution (11520x5120) confirmed via Elegoo US store and West3D. Regular MSRP $523.99 (~$524) confirmed on West3D; sale price ~$379.99. Auto-leveling confirmed.

products.name: Sovol SV08
products.priceNote: Regular published price $599; sometimes discounted to ~$549
products.provenance: Build volume 350x350x345 mm, max speed 700 mm/s (40,000 mm/s2 accel), hotend 300C, 4-Z-motor auto-leveling, open-frame CoreXY (Voron 2.4 inspired, ~90% pre-assembled) confirmed via Sovol product page and Tom's Hardware. priceUsd set to the published regular price $599 (cited 3DPros figure of $549 reflects a discount). No multicolor.
